from pathlib import Path
trace = [
  {"step":1,"file":"fuzz/wget_options_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":104,"var":"config.dont_write","code":"config.dont_write = 1;","note":"Attacker-controlled fuzzer bytes are routed into the options parser while write-side effects are disabled, so config parsing proceeds on the supplied input."},
  {"step":2,"file":"fuzz/wget_options_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":113,"var":"init(...)","code":"init(sizeof(argv)/sizeof(argv[0]), argv);","note":"The fuzzer invokes wget2 initialization with a fixed --config argument that causes the program to read a synthetic config file path backed by the fuzzer input."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/options.c","function":"read_config_expand","line":2640,"var":"cfgfile","code":"if (expand) { glob_t globbuf = { .gl_pathc = 0 }; if (glob(cfgfile, GLOB_MARK | GLOB_TILDE, NULL, &globbuf) == 0) ...","note":"The config filename is expanded with glob(), so the attacker-controlled path is resolved into one or more concrete filenames before parsing."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/options.c","function":"read_config_expand","line":2662,"var":"globbuf.gl_pathv[it]","code":"ret = read_config_expand(globbuf.gl_pathv[it], 0);","note":"Each matched filename is recursively parsed, and the same path string is reused after globfree() releases the glob result storage."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/options.c","function":"read_config_expand","line":2670,"var":"fp","code":"fp = fopen(cfgfile, \"r\");","note":"The parser opens the selected config file and begins reading attacker-controlled lines from it."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/options.c","function":"read_config_expand","line":2718,"var":"linep","code":"found = parse_option(linep, &name, &val);","note":"Each line is tokenized into an option name/value pair, allowing an include directive to be introduced by the attacker."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/options.c","function":"read_config_expand","line":2725,"var":"val","code":"if (!strcmp(name, \"include\")) { ret = read_config_expand(val, 1); }","note":"An include option causes recursive expansion of another attacker-controlled path, re-entering the glob/open path handling."},
  {"step":8,"file":"gnulib/lib/glob.c","function":"glob","line":273,"var":"pglob","code":"glob (const char *pattern, int flags, int (*errfunc) (const char *, int), glob_t *pglob)","note":"The glob implementation allocates and later frees path vectors while the caller still uses the returned strings, creating the use-after-free condition when the recursive config path is revisited."},
  {"step":9,"file":"gnulib/lib/glob.c","function":"glob","line":429,"var":"pglob","code":"globfree (pglob);","note":"On recursive brace expansion/error handling, globfree releases the path vector backing storage that downstream code still references."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/options.c","function":"read_config_expand","line":2662,"var":"globbuf.gl_pathv[it]","code":"read_config_expand(globbuf.gl_pathv[it], 0);","note":"The freed glob path string is dereferenced again on the recursive descent, which is the memory-safety sink that ASAN reports as a heap-use-after-free read."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('wrote trace')
